name: Sin Fetish Audio
author: Sin Fetish Audio
tagline: Alien Stack: Nordics, Mantis, Reptiles, Greys and the Ship
description: Alien Stack: five visitors in one groovebox. Nordics (poly synth), Mantis (synthesized drums, 8 kits), Reptiles (alien bass bank + synth basses), Greys (sampler), the Ship (8 patterns, scenes, a song, parameter locks, polymeter, a reverb bus). MIDI channels 1-4 play Nordics, Mantis, Reptiles, Greys.
credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
